name: Direct Traffic Web CBO Campaign Operations
scope: Meta CBO campaigns with external website destination
from-zero, exact duplication and structure clone with new media
account-scoped on-demand media upload after the exact request account is known
manifest validation, quota, recovery and consolidated readback
Drive and inventory lifecycle after platform readback

shared_campaign_mechanics.media_pipeline: parallel on-demand after exact account resolution; reconcile deterministic titles once, reuse partial variants, batch ready/association validation and commit registry only after all gates pass
shared_campaign_mechanics.recovery: readback first; same request and persisted IDs; missing or invalid layer only

operation_parameters_required: account, Page, pixel, event and timezone
ad-serving capability: direct or lineage required

page_policy.rule: SHEIN and CAR Pages may be assigned in the authorized Business Manager; runtime still validates the exact Page and ADVERTISE capability before writes

media_policy.upload_timing: only after the campaign request names the exact ad account
media_policy.variants: declared by operation; SHEIN may use vertical-only while CAR may require vertical+square

isolation.shared: campaign mechanics, media pipeline, batching, quota, recovery and readback
isolation.operation_owned: IDs, URLs, UTMs, copy, assets, event, compliance, source selection, schedule, budget and lifecycle strategy
